gloss: if you don't mind; if it's not a problem

definitions.gloss: if you don't mind; if it's not a problem; if it's okay with you
definitions.explanation: A polite expression used to preface a request or question, showing consideration for the other person's circumstances. Implies that the speaker will accept a refusal. Very common in polite and business Japanese.

examples.japanese: {差|さ}し{支|つか}えなければ、⟦お{名前|なまえ}→お名前：22188_onamae⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{教|おし}えて→教える：00526_oshieru⟧⟦いただけます→いただく：01326_itadaku⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: If you don't mind, could you tell me your name?

examples.japanese: {差|さ}し{支|つか}えなければ、⟦{理由|りゆう}→理由：01102_riyuu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧お⟦{聞|き}かせ→聞く：00483_kiku⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: If it's not a problem, please tell me the reason.

examples.japanese: {差|さ}し{支|つか}えなければ、⟦{来週|らいしゅう}→来週：00746_raishuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{月曜日|げつようび}→月曜日：00624_getsuyoubi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦お{時間|じかん}→お時間：30572_ojikan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦いただけない→いただく：01326_itadaku⟧でしょう⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: If it wouldn't be any trouble, could I have some of your time next Monday?

notes:
USAGE:
A polite set phrase used to soften requests and personal questions. Very common in business emails, customer service, and formal conversations. The base form is ⟦{差|さ}し{支|つか}える→差し支える：05915_sashitsukaeru⟧ (to be inconvenient/problematic), and ⟦なければ→ない：01118_nai⟧ is the conditional negative (if not). Can also appear as ⟦{差|さ}し{支|つか}えなかったら→差し支える：05915_sashitsukaeru⟧ (slightly less formal) or ⟦{差|さ}し{支|つか}え→差し支える：05915_sashitsukaeru⟧⟦ございませ→ございます：01300_gozaimasu⟧んでしたら (very formal/humble).

FORMALITY VARIANTS:
- ⟦{差|さ}し{支|つか}え→差し支える：05915_sashitsukaeru⟧⟦ございませ→ございます：01300_gozaimasu⟧んでしたら (very formal)
- {差|さ}し{支|つか}えなければ (standard polite)
- ⟦{差|さ}し{支|つか}えなかったら→差し支える：05915_sashitsukaeru⟧ (slightly less formal)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦よろしければ→よろしい：01176_yoroshii⟧: if it's okay with you — a simpler and slightly less formal alternative
- ⟦もし→もし：01284_moshi⟧⟦よければ→いい：00118_ii⟧: if you'd like — even more casual
- ⟦ご{迷惑|めいわく}→ご迷惑：28069_gomeiwaku⟧でなければ: if it's not a bother — similar meaning, less common
